title: Finite Element Eigenfunction Network (FEENet): A Hybrid Framework for Solving PDEs on Complex Geometries
summary: Neural operators aim to learn mappings between infinite-dimensional function spaces, but their performance often degrades on complex or irregular geometries due to the lack of geometry-aware representations. We propose the Finite Element Eigenfunction Network (FEENet), a hybrid spectral learning framework grounded in the eigenfunction theory of differential operators.
